title: Padlock
summary: PAD'LOCK, noun A lock to be hung on a staple and held by a link. PAD'LOCK, verb transitive To fasten with a padlock; to stop; to shut; to confine.

inlines.v: PAD'LOCK, noun A lock to be hung on a staple and held by a link. PAD'LOCK, verb transitive To fasten with a padlock; to stop; to shut; to confine.
